title: Lumen Ridge / Corvane — respond to customer redline of the Master Subscription Agreement against the firm playbook
instructions:
We act for Lumen Ridge Software, Inc. (Provider). Corvane Logistics Group, Inc. (Customer) has returned a marked-up version of our Form MSA v4.2 with its changes numbered in the margin. Using our negotiation playbook, prepare our response to Corvane's markup.

Produce a negotiation response memo containing:
1. A response table with exactly one row per numbered change, columns: Change | Clause | Disposition | Counter-position / rationale | Playbook ref. The Disposition column must contain exactly one of the words ACCEPT, COUNTER or REJECT in capitals. For every COUNTER, state the specific counter-position (numbers, periods, conditions) the playbook permits.
2. A comparison of the markup against the version we sent, identifying any change the counterparty made without marking it, and our response to it.
3. A short cover email to Corvane's counsel summarising our position on the key risk-allocation points.

Quote the operative language (from the markup, the form as sent, and the playbook) verbatim for each position.
